dedupe_keys.name: flood detection using grace terrestrial water storage and extreme precipitation

description: The GRACE flood-day research team publishes historical flood indicators derived from terrestrial-water-storage anomalies and extreme precipitation. The product covers 60 degrees south to 60 degrees north at 1 degree resolution from 1 April 2002 to 31 August 2016. Filtering, anomaly detection and a flood-potential index combine the inputs into flood-day estimates. Zenodo supplies the results as a public RAR archive, free under CC-BY-4.0. The repository reports comparisons with Dartmouth Flood Observatory events, MODIS observations and river discharge, but these performance claims were not independently reproduced. Coarse cells and the indirect storage signal limit suitability for local water depths or the exact footprint of a damaged asset. The indicators could support basin-level checks of historical flood scenarios before coupling them to infrastructure exposure. They complement event-report inventories with a satellite-based detection route. Internal file encoding remains unverified.
